meta.name: dev-cancel
meta.description: Cleanly stop an active engineering layer flow (dev-autopilot, dev-deep-interview, dev-plan) and report what was completed. Use when the user says "cancel", "stop", "abort", "cancelomc", or wants to exit a multi-phase dev workflow.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 停止正在运行的开发流程并报告完成情况
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要干净地中断多阶段开发工作流
copy.tagline_en: Stop an active development flow and report completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to cleanly stop a multi-phase dev workflow

howto.what: 当你说“取消”或“停止”时，Claude会立即停止正在进行的工程工作流（如自动编程、深度访谈、计划），并生成一份结构化报告，显示已完成、进行中和未开始的任务，同时保留所有工作文件以便后续继续。
howto.when: 当你说出“cancel”、“stop”、“abort”或“cancelomc”等触发词，或者想要退出多阶段开发流程（如自动编程、深度访谈）时触发。

say.note: Claude会停止工作并生成取消报告。
Claude会终止任务但不删除任何文件。

howto.what_en: When the user says 'cancel' or 'stop', Claude cleanly halts any active engineering workflow (dev-autopilot, dev-deep-interview, dev-plan) and outputs a structured report showing what was completed, in progress, and not started, preserving all artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'cancel', 'stop', 'abort', or 'cancelomc', or wants to exit a multi-phase dev flow like dev-autopilot or dev-deep-interview.

say_en.note: Claude stops and generates a cancel report.
